answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 45451 Country: Pakistan Title: Ghusl Question: When I have bath (ghusl) I wet my body completely but after 4 or 5 minutes I wash myself once again and repeat my ghusl again because of waswasa that my body would have become dry. My question is do I have to repeat washing my body again once it is washed completely if a part of the body becomes a bit dry or I do not have to repeat my ghusl. Please give me answer because I am troubled a lot of this issue. Answer ID: 45451 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 859/795/N=1434) When you performed ghusl once properly i.e. you poured water to each and every part of your body then there is no need of ghusl again after four or five minutes when your body was dried. Do not repeat your ghusl due to baseless doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
